verdict.rationale: Namecheap documents its own API, with a sandbox endpoint and an official Go SDK. The SDK covers core domain operations: availability check, charge-bearing registration and renewal, registrar lock, and listing TLDs with per-TLD API capabilities. An official Terraform provider covers DNS records. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the full UI feature set, and the per-TLD capability listing suggests coverage varies. Missing for 10: any statement or evidence of full UI/API parity, coverage of account, billing, transfer and privacy management via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: CreateWithContext(ctx, args) | Register a new domain (charge-bearing)
